persistence.git_publication: Authorized independent evidence-only child of 0b5bf; containing commit/ref and full readback are reported separately.
persistence.local_environment: Explicitly unavailable; no local output creation or process inspection claimed.

current_receiver.permission: Do not read child bodies until Root confirms exact original receiver request/receipt/returned-owner binding, ECHILD, empty remaining children, and permits read-only audit. Do not infer termination from wall time. No restart or new references.

root_reported_latest_state.verification: Root-reported only; not independent child-output read

source_proofs.method: Full raw Git bytes plus blob object hash and size, each joined to exact pure tree; no imports or product parse/run.

required_checks: Exact unique original names and indices; no duplicate-row folding
Every copy path equals held fixed root plus index-derived leaf
Full bytes/sha256/CRC32 match selection row and complete original inventory
No truncation; complete_all_member_bodies true; expected full counts and exact original artifact hash
Parent independent full readback and complete current output custody are separate from original product success
Use strict JSON duplicate-key and integer-preserving parsing for forensic joins; never coerce bool to integer
selected_lookup.unselected_boundary: Complete archive inventory hashes these bodies, but the fixed 460 copy set does not materialize them. Do not claim selected-body access or enlarge extraction scope.

bindings: raw receipt request_sha256 == exact raw request sha256
implementation_sha256 == exact pure source/cold source-manifest owner SHA256
returned_owner minus supervisor_returncode/receipt_sha256 == entire raw receipt with exact integers
recorded argv/cwd/paths/env bind to original remote context, not relocated local paths
request qualification_seconds exact int180 and cleanup_seconds exact int3; received deadline fields preserve raw integer precision
independent_facts: Preserve every true timeout/interruption/cleanup/error fact even when higher-priority status wins
SIGKILL only if owned_child_sigkill event exists
Do not require exactly 4 events; adopted child observations and reaps are allowed
Match all observed/reaped identities by pid/start_ticks; missing closure is OPEN
A closed nonzero original owner supports custody, not qualification
Returned wrapper status OWNED_COMMAND_RETURNED_PENDING_READBACK is not owner natural PASS
natural_qualification_fields: owner_error absent/null as required by original reader
natural allowed event kinds only and required started/exit_observed/reaped
supervisor_returncode int0 and exact receipt sha

report_rules: Read innermost available complete raw cause before outer propagation messages. Keep secondary preservation/progress/finalization exceptions separately.
A missing report only establishes missing original. It does not prove timeout, missing execution, or a particular method hang.
For each original group require ordered loaded_ids and executed_ids equal frozen ids, tests_run exact expected count, loader_errors and five anomaly arrays empty before calling that group passed.
test_stop and native returns are observations, never method PASS. Validate original result/anomalies independently.
Original reports are written during normal/finally unwinding; owner kill or other abrupt termination can prevent all enclosing reports.
If explicit failures cannot be ordered by timestamps/progress/producer control flow, return incomparable failure candidates instead of inventing a unique earliest cause.
Do not re-invoke current-environment gate functions on relocated artifacts; compare original recorded remote identities and exact bytes offline.

stream_checks: Complete raw bytes stay unchanged; complete validator requires final LF
sequence exact integers 0..n-1; time/native counts nonnegative monotonic exact integers
group/order/loaded-id digest match the fixed 116 list
fixture stack is paired LIFO by kind+subject
one running test, matching test_start/test_stop; increasing frozen ID order
operation_end occurs once and last; complete receipt binds exact original report, raw progress hash/bytes, source/runtime and event count

prefix_diagnosis_only.meaning: Stopped inside this class/module fixture hook window; no method PASS/hang attribution
Inside TestCase.run including per-test setup, body and cleanup; not proof the method body hung

prefix_diagnosis_only.tail: group_begin with neither active test nor fixture
prefix_diagnosis_only.meaning: Between hooks or group control/loader/result processing
After progress admission; original caller Core39 build/admission/discovery window

prefix_diagnosis_only.tail: progress missing or no valid operation_begin
prefix_diagnosis_only.meaning: Before recorded progress, or recording/custody failure; exact earlier cause remains unknown
Retain raw and longest valid prefix with exact rejected byte/line; incomplete progress never qualifies

fixture_outcomes.normal_return: Hook returned; does not prove test PASS
fixture_outcomes.fixture_error: unittest recorded fixture error even if no BaseException escaped
fixture_outcomes.base_exception: Original hook escaped BaseException; exception_type required

progress.callback_rule: test_stop.callback must be stopTest; exception_type null/string; it is not an assertion outcome
progress.completion_rule: COMPLETE receipt, complete true, logging_errors [], error null, full 116 starts/stops/group ordering and original report exact join all required; an ended false/incomplete stream remains diagnostic only

planned_owner_image_compiles.scope: Only the known three B3 companion images and two complete Core39 bundle builds; not total native actions inside 116 test methods, and not actual completion.
receipt_rules: status timeout is explicit 20-second child timeout; preserve original receipt and stderr
status child_failed preserves actual returncode and stderr
successful compile_stage requires returned, abi_status0, source_unchanged, no forbidden compiler modules, 0<core_u32<=1048576, output extent bound, produced SHA
A failure receipt may lack produced_* fields; retain it and do not parse it as successful build
Only after all required units and stable inputs does build.json/top manifest appear
Frozen 460 set includes receipt/request/stdout/stderr/manifest/build; full output/image bytes remain inventory-only here

first_boundary_algorithm.name: current_receiver_closed_custody
first_boundary_algorithm.rule: Root permission then exact current returned-owner/raw request/receipt closure; complete inventory/readback joins. No inferred completion.

first_boundary_algorithm.name: original_owner_outcome
first_boundary_algorithm.rule: Compute precedence from raw owner fields; separately preserve all facts and contradictions.

first_boundary_algorithm.name: first_explicit_inner_failure
first_boundary_algorithm.rule: Walk executed build/report/group/progress evidence in actual producer order. Only an explicit failure can name the boundary.

first_boundary_algorithm.name: last_positive_boundary
first_boundary_algorithm.rule: Acknowledge only evidenced completed items; report active interrupted window separately.

first_boundary_algorithm.name: secondary_failure_and_gaps
first_boundary_algorithm.rule: Never overwrite primary evidence with a later generic propagated error or missing-file exception.

first_boundary_algorithm.name: result
first_boundary_algorithm.rule: No product/source/runtime conclusion from artifact integrity alone; original FAIL and recovery HOLD remain historical facts.

exclusion: No new provider references, artifact GET, receiver, owner or CI. Only the separately authorized static Git evidence commit/ref may be written.
No budget, denominator, source, selector, or evidence selection changes
No current recovery output read before Root bound closure confirmation
